definition: No known deterministic repository or workflow defect is present on the exact observed head under the explicitly bound deterministic local audit surface. Platform runtime evidence is a separate promotion condition and is never self-asserted by the local auditor.

local_commands: python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.test_qikvrt_zero_bug tests.test_qikvrt_perfect_optimum tests.test_qikvrt_bit_audit tests.test_qikvrt_repository_writer_lease

bit_audit.source: git object database at exact HEAD

platform_promotion_surface.scope: separate live GitHub platform observation on the same exact head

base_algorithm.authority: Ingolf Lohmann, Product Owner: September 8, 2026 debugging directive
base_algorithm.mandatory_scope: Every detected error and blocker, including repair failures, missing evidence and unavailable capabilities
base_algorithm.repeat: Apply the same work unit contract to each discovered cause, prerequisite blocker and follow-up failure until all known obligations in the bound scope are closed by evidence
base_algorithm.independent_work: Remain eligible; an unavailable dependency blocks only its dependent work units
base_algorithm.causality: Explicit blocked_by/causes references and receipt after links; never timestamps, PR numbers or input order
base_algorithm.closure: Complete freshly observed inventory, exact current base/head/tree receipts for symptom and cause correction, identified causal mechanism, same-test red/green regression, original-flow readback and no open descendant
base_algorithm.prior_obligations: Persist and reconcile existing work-unit/ledger/artifact receipts; a later clean probe or NOOP never deletes an unresolved cause
base_algorithm.subject_mutation: Reset P2+ and require fresh downstream bindings; preserve predecessor records as history only
base_algorithm.capability_boundary: Investigate and repair using already authorized capabilities; otherwise retain the exact open obligation and REQUEST_AUTHORITY without impersonation, blind retry or invented effects
base_algorithm.effect_authority: Reuse existing registered writers and exact-scope delegations; this algorithm grants no new write, signing, administrative or external authority
